history.text: The Kingdom of Rwanda expanded under successive mwami.
Germany claimed the territory; Belgium took over after 1916.
The genocide against the Tutsi killed an estimated 800,000 people in about a hundred days.
A new constitution was adopted and reconstruction accelerated.
